resources.string: Paper Ops (light) by day and Quiet Ops (dark) by night when Auto is selected. Boundaries use your chosen timezone. Default is manual timezone — the network is never contacted for location unless you opt in below.
IANA timezone for local day/night (JVM default until you pick one). Manual selection never phones home.

Opt-in only. When enabled, Telos makes a one-shot request to a public IP→geo endpoint to learn timezone and country code. Only those values (and optional coordinates for sunrise/sunset) are stored in vault desktop.properties. Your IP is not logged, there is no continuous tracking, and themes are not synced to the cloud. If the network fails, kill-switch is on, or you are offline, Telos keeps your manual timezone and shows Preference only or Failed honestly.
Preference only — network assist off, blocked, or not requested; using manual timezone
Failed — could not reach the geo endpoint; keeping manual timezone
